name: Ever Rendering
definition: A real-time volumetric rendering method using ellipsoids that blends together to constitute a proper and consistent 3D radiance field, avoiding the 2D billboard approximation of 3DGS Gaussians.
summary: Ever Rendering is a real-time volumetric method using constant-density ellipsoids that replaces rasterization with ray tracing to enable exact transmittance calculation without approximation errors.
